frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Loss of the connecting way/track between an entity and its intended target, such that arrival or retrieval fails. Two symmetrical faces of one relation: subject-side, a mover (person, deed, effort, memory-item, body) no longer holds the line to its goal and so does not arrive (astray, wasted, forgotten); observer-side, the entity drops off the seeker's track and becomes unfindable/unavailable (vanished, of no avail). Form IV adds causation of this track-loss; the nouns name the resulting off-track state.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Loss of the connecting way/track between an entity and its intended target, such that arrival or retrieval fails. Two symmetrical faces of one relation: subject-side, a mover (person, deed, effort, memory-item, body) no longer holds the line to its goal and so does not arrive (astray, wasted, forgotten); observer-side, the entity drops off the seeker's track and becomes unfindable/unavailable (vanished, of no avail). Form IV adds causation of this track-loss; the nouns name the resulting off-track state.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 191 occurrences the root marks one situation: something that should be connected to a destination by a way loses that way. A person strays from God's path (dalla 'an sabilihi, 16:125, 68:7); a fabricated deity 'strays away from' its worshippers, i.e. cannot be found or reached when needed (dalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftarun, 10:30 and nine parallels; 7:37 dallu 'anna); deeds and effort 'stray', i.e. never arrive at their reward (18:104; 47:1 adalla a'malahum, negated in 47:4); a witness 'strays' from a memory item until the other reminds her (2:282); God never 'strays' from what is recorded nor forgets (20:52); dead bodies 'stray in the earth', becoming untraceable (32:10); a plot is put into tadlil, made to travel without arriving (105:2). The constant antonym pairing with h-d-y (guidance along a way) in dozens of verses confirms the residue: not moral evil as such, but way-loss relative to a target — with religion, morality, memory, or physical location supplied by context.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: Form I = be/become off-track (intransitive, or with bare object al-sabil = lose the way, 25:17, 33:67); Form IV = cause track-loss in another (God, Satan, Pharaoh, al-Samiri, elites, idols) or in things (deeds, 47:1); Form II verbal noun tadlil (105:2) = putting into a state of path-failure; participles mudill (causer) and dall(un) (one in the state). CONSTRUCTION: 'an + [path/person] marks what the track connected to — dalla 'an sabilihi (off the way) vs dalla 'anhum (lost to them); the seeker/goal is a construction slot, not root content. CONTEXT: religious misguidance, memory failure (2:282, paired with tudhakkir), physical untraceability (32:10), futility of deeds/petitions (13:14, 40:50), and speaker-relative accusations (12:8, 12:30, 12:95) are all contextual colorings of the same residue. The moral-condemnation reading is context, not root: 20:52, 2:282, 32:10 carry the root with zero moral content.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 20:52 'la yadillu rabbi wa-la yansa' (My Lord does not dall nor forget) — no path, no morality, no misguidance is available here, so any 'religious error' hypothesis fails outright. It survives only under the track-loss residue: knowledge is in a record, and God never loses the track to any item in it; the pairing with nasiya (forget) confirms dall as retrieval-failure. Same pressure from 2:282 ('an tadilla ihdahuma fa-tudhakkir...' — a witness losing the memory-track, cured by reminding) and 32:10 (bodies dall in the earth = untraceable).
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: 'Religious misguidance / moral error' as the root meaning. Rejected as root residue: it cannot cover 20:52 (God as subject of la yadillu), 2:282 (witness memory), 32:10 (corpses lost in the earth), 18:104/47:1-47:8 (deeds and effort lost), or the ten-verse formula dalla 'anhum ma kanu yaftarun where fabricated deities vanish from their worshippers. A second competitor, 'perishing/annihilation', fails at 93:7 (wajadaka dallan fa-hada — the lost one is guided, not destroyed) and 2:282 (the witness is reminded, not perished). The moral reading is the dominant contextual application, not the invariant contribution.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: vs h-d-y: exact structural antonym — paired explicitly in ~40 of the 191 occurrences (yudillu man yasha'u wa-yahdi man yasha'u, etc.); hda = being set/kept on the connecting way, dll = losing it. vs g-w-y: 53:2 conjoins 'ma dalla sahibukum wa-ma ghawa', so they are non-synonymous; ghawa targets errant desire/aim, dll targets way-loss. vs t-y-h (wandering): tyh is aimless motion within a space; dll is specifically severance from the track to a definite target (hence 'an + goal constructions, impossible with tyh). vs kh-s-r: 7:178 makes khusran the consequence of idlal, not its content. vs d-y-'a (waste): dll retains the findability/arrival dimension (a dall thing can be found again, 93:7), while dy' is pure forfeiture. The residue is non-empty, distinctive, and falsifiable: an occurrence of Dll denoting destruction, moral evil, or loss with no way/target/retrieval dimension would break it; none exists in the packet.
internal_discovery.rationale: Full coverage: all 191 confirmed occurrences read and individually assessed. The occurrences cluster cleanly by form and construction: (A) Form I + 'an sabil (way-loss by a person: 16:125, 53:30, 68:7, 6:117, 38:26, 2:108, 5:12, 60:1); (B) Form I with the invoked/fabricated thing as subject + 'an + person (object lost to its seeker: 10:30, 11:21, 16:87, 28:75, 41:48, 46:28, 6:24, 6:94, 7:53, 7:37, 40:74, 17:67); (C) non-moral track-loss (20:52, 2:282, 32:10, 18:104); (D) Form IV causatives, 64x, with persons or deeds (47:1, 47:8, negated 47:4) as object, in constant antonymy with yahdi; (E) nouns dalal/dalala for the state, including futile petition (13:14, 40:50) and purchase metaphors (2:16, 2:175, 4:44); (F) tadlil 105:2; (G) participles (1:7, 15:56, 56:51, 68:26, 83:32, 93:7). Every resistant case was deep-analyzed and reconciles under 'loss of the connecting track to a target' once form (causation), construction ('an-phrase slot), and context (religion, memory, location, deeds) are subtracted. No occurrence requires a second core. Strength STRONG because the residue survives its hardest tests (20:52, 2:282, 32:10, 105:2) rather than merely fitting the easy majority, and because the h-d-y antonym pairing provides internal structural confirmation across dozens of verses. Nothing here is canonical; this is an internal-evidence research judgment only.

adversarial_verification.notes: Full coverage: all 191 occurrences examined and accounted for. Under an adversarial pass I could not produce a single confirmed occurrence where the proposed contribution ('loss of the connecting way/track between an entity and its intended target, arrival/retrieval fails', with symmetrical subject-side off-track and observer-side vanished/unavailable faces, Form IV = causation) is demonstrably ABSENT. Clusters: (1) path/guidance off-track majority (e.g. 1:7, 6:117, 14:3, 22:9, 38:26; comparatives 7:179, 25:44) — subject face; (2) observer-side vanish/of-no-avail: 'ضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون' (10:30,11:21,16:87,28:75,41:48,6:24,6:94,7:53), 'ضل من تدعون' (17:67), 'ضلوا عنا' (7:37,40:74,46:28); (3) wasted deed / failed scheme / unanswered prayer: 18:104 (سعيهم), 105:2 (تضليل II), 40:25/40:50/13:14 (دعاء/كيد في ضلال), 47:1/47:4/47:8 (أعمالهم); (4) memory/retrieval: 20:52 (لا يضل...ولا ينسى) and 2:282 (أن تضل...فتذكر) — both paired with forget/remind, matching the enumerated memory face; (5) body dissolved/unfindable: 32:10 (ضللنا في الأرض); (6) error of belief/judgment: 12:8,12:30,12:95,7:61,93:7, reconciled via target=sound judgment/guidance (loose but present). The negated uses (53:2,20:52,20:123,9:115,93:7) affirm on-track and are consistent, not counterexamples. Distinctiveness holds: separated from غوي (independently negated in 53:2), from نسي (paired-but-distinct in 20:52), and contrasted with هدى/اهتدى throughout. Falsifiable: a target-reaching use or a wholly target-less/positive use would break it; none occurs. RESIDUAL RISK (not a refutation): the definition attains universality partly by being a disjunction of five outcome-glosses; it is broad and some belief/judgment cases (12:8,12:30,12:95) reconcile only loosely. Verdict SUPPORTED because every occurrence is reconcilable to the single track-to-target-loss relation and no occurrence is unreconciled; nothing here is canonical.
